expected.title: 2022 Ford Escape SE
expected.dealer_description:
This 2022 Ford Escape SE in Black delivers practical daily driving with a refined approach to compact SUV ownership.

- 1.5L EcoBoost® engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- SE Sport Appearance Package with 19" machined-face aluminum wheels
- Convenience Package including dual-zone climate control and 8-way power driver seat
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- SYNC® 3 communications and entertainment system with SiriusXM
- Halogen projector headlamps with LED signature and configurable daytime running lamps
- Exterior rear parking camera
- Fold-down rear center armrest with cupholders
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- Split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo configuration
- FordPass Connect integration
- SYNC® 3 911 Assist emergency communication system

The powertrain balances efficiency with capability, delivering 28 city and 34 highway miles per gallon. This configuration suits drivers who value both responsiveness in urban environments and composed highway performance without compromise.

The Sport Appearance Package elevates the visual presence with its distinctive 19-inch wheels and gloss black grille treatment, while the black bumpers and mirror caps reinforce a cohesive design aesthetic. The interior reflects a driver-focused approach with the 8-way power driver seat offering multiple adjustment options, including lumbar support and recline functionality.

Climate management through dual-zone electronic automatic temperature control ensures all occupants maintain their preferred comfort levels. The power liftgate removes a daily friction point, making loading and unloading intuitive. SYNC® 3 integrates smartphone connectivity and entertainment seamlessly, while the rear parking camera provides confidence during maneuvers.

Safety systems include four-wheel independent suspension for composed handling, electronic stability control, and comprehensive airbag protection. The four-wheel disc braking system with ABS delivers responsive stopping power across varied driving conditions.

This Escape SE represents straightforward, capable transportation with thoughtful comfort features and modern conveniences that support your daily routine. Visit us to experience how it fits your driving needs.

Main Features: Black Upper Window Molding w/Black Beltline Molding
Gloss Black 5-Bar Upper Grille w/Chrome Surround

Fold-Down Rear Center Armrest w/2 Cupholders

expected.title: 2026 Ford F-350SD LARIAT
expected.engine: 6.7L High Output Power Stroke V8 Diesel
expected.dealer_description:
The 2026 Ford F-350SD LARIAT is built for serious work and genuine capability. This white diesel powerhouse brings together premium refinement and rugged functionality designed to handle demanding tasks while delivering the comfort you deserve.

- 6.7L High Output Power Stroke V8 Diesel with 10-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- FX4 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and tuned shock absorbers
- 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package for seamless trailer integration
- Twin Panel Power Moonroof with map lights
- Chrome Package featuring chrome door handles, mirror caps, and exhaust tip
- SYNC® 4 with 12" center display and Connected Navigation
- B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with SiriusXM 360L
- Tough Bed Spray-In Bedliner with tailgate guard and Bed tie-down hooks
- Heavy-Service Front Suspension Package for enhanced capability
- Soft Folding Tonneau Pickup Box Cover for Bed protection
- Dual AGM 68 AH Battery with 190 Amp Alternator
- Heated and ventilated front seats with memory positioning
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone air conditioning
- 6 Upfitter Switches in overhead console for custom equipment integration

The diesel engine delivers the performance you need for towing and hauling, while the comprehensive tech integration keeps you connected throughout your day. The FX4 Off-Road Package adds genuine capability with specialized suspension tuning and protection, making this truck ready for both job sites and challenging terrain. The cabin reflects LARIAT refinement with premium seating, dual-zone climate control, and the sophisticated B&O sound system that transforms your daily drives.

Advanced safety features including BLIS with Cross-Traffic Alert, 4-wheel disc ABS brakes, dual front airbags, and electronic stability control work together to protect you and your passengers. The rear parking sensors and auto high-beam headlights add practical convenience to everyday operation.

The exterior combines professional presence with smart design. Chrome accents enhance the overall appearance while the fully automatic LED headlights provide superior visibility. Privacy glass and the unique FX4 Off-Road Box decal reinforce this truck's distinctive character and capability focus.

This F-350SD LARIAT is equipped to excel whether you're managing a fleet, running a construction operation, or tackling serious towing responsibilities. The combination of diesel efficiency, purposeful engineering, and genuine comfort makes this the kind of truck that earns respect on every job.

We invite you to experience this truck firsthand. Visit our showroom to sit behind the wheel and discover why the F-350SD LARIAT remains the trusted choice for those who demand both capability and quality.

expected.title: 2025 Honda Accord LX
expected.dealer_description:
The 2025 Honda Accord LX delivers reliable performance and practical comfort for drivers who value dependability and efficiency. This gray sedan combines modern technology with straightforward functionality, offering a balanced choice for daily commuting and weekend drives.

- 1.5T turbocharged VTEC engine with CVT transmission
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow
- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS)
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity
- 160-Watt audio system with steering wheel controls
- Automatic temperature control with rear window defroster
- Power windows, doors, and mirrors with remote keyless entry
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off and auto high-beam features
- Exterior parking camera with rear view
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- 17-inch alloy wheels
- Dual front and side airbags plus knee and overhead airbags
- Emergency communication system with HondaLink Assist
- Security system with panic alarm

Under the hood, the turbocharged four-cylinder engine balances power with efficiency, delivering 29 city miles per gallon and 37 highway miles per gallon for economical driving. The continuously variable transmission provides smooth acceleration while helping maximize fuel economy, making this Accord an intelligent choice for budget-conscious drivers.

Safety technology is integrated throughout this sedan. Adaptive Cruise Control monitors traffic and adjusts your speed automatically, while Lane Keeping Assist System helps maintain your position in the lane. The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front, dual front side, knee, and overhead protection. Electronic Stability Control and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident handling in various driving conditions.

The interior prioritizes comfort and convenience. Automatic temperature control keeps the cabin at your preferred setting, while front bucket seats with a center armrest offer supportive seating. The steering wheel is both tilt and telescoping, allowing you to find your ideal driving position. Illuminated entry and reading lights throughout the cabin enhance usability in Low-light conditions.

Connectivity features keep you engaged and informed. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration allows seamless smartphone integration through the audio system. The trip computer displays real-time vehicle information, while the compass and outside temperature display provide additional data at a glance. Power windows, mirrors, and door locks add everyday convenience.

This 2025 Honda Accord LX is ready for immediate delivery and represents solid value for buyers seeking a well-equipped sedan. Contact us today to schedule a test drive and experience the quality and efficiency this vehicle offers firsthand.

Main Features: Lane departure: Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS) active
Adaptive Cruise Control: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) with Low-Speed Follow

expected.title: 2022 Ford Mustang Mach-E Select
expected.dealer_description:
This 2022 Ford Mustang Mach-E Select combines modern electric efficiency with practical everyday functionality, making it an excellent choice for drivers seeking a vehicle that performs while keeping fuel costs manageable.

- Comfort & Technology Package with Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0
- Heated front Row seats and heated steering wheel
- BlueCruise Hands-Free Driving technology
- 360-degree camera system with split view
- Active Park Assist 2.0
- Memory driver's seat and side-view mirrors
- 8-inch touchscreen with SYNC® 4A and enhanced voice recognition
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM Radio with 360L
- Hands-free foot-activated liftgate with power functionality
- Connected Navigation system
- 18-inch carbonized gray-painted aluminum wheels
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- Clean Carfax report

The white exterior presents a clean, contemporary look that stands out on the road while maintaining a professional appearance suitable for any setting. At 35,555 miles, this Mach-E remains in its prime, with plenty of service life ahead while still carrying the benefits of modern manufacturing quality.

Electric efficiency is a defining strength of this vehicle, delivering an estimated 110 MPGe in city driving and 96 MPGe on the highway. These numbers translate to lower operating costs and reduced environmental impact without sacrificing the performance and handling characteristics drivers expect from the Mustang nameplate.

Inside, the cabin prioritizes comfort and connectivity. The Comfort & Technology Package furnishes the interior with heated front seats and a heated steering wheel—particularly valuable during colder months. The memory driver's seat adjusts automatically to your preferred position, while the 360-degree camera system with split-view capability provides confidence during parking and maneuvering in tight spaces.

Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0 and Active Park Assist 2.0 work together to support your driving by monitoring surroundings and helping manage vehicle positioning. BlueCruise Hands-Free Driving enhances highway driving by reducing fatigue on longer trips. The SYNC® 4A system with enhanced voice recognition keeps navigation and entertainment control intuitive and safe while your focus remains on the road.

This Select model represents an accessible entry into electric vehicle ownership without compromising on the features and technology that make daily driving more enjoyable. The combination of efficiency, practical technology, and thoughtful comfort features makes this Mach-E a dependable vehicle for commuting, weekend drives, and everything in between.
